mapper.select: SELECT login_code_hash FROM test_account WHERE user_id=#{id}
mapper.sql:
FROM test_account t JOIN user_account u ON u.id=t.user_id
AND (u.email_key ILIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%' OR u.account_code ILIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%') AND t.disabled_at IS NULL AND t.expires_at > #{now} AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND (t.disable_reason='MANUAL' OR (t.disabled_at IS NULL AND u.status!='ACTIVE' AND t.expires_at > #{now})) AND (t.disable_reason='EXPIRED' OR (t.disabled_at IS NULL AND t.expires_at <= #{now}))
mapper.update: UPDATE test_account SET disabled_at=#{now},disable_reason=#{reason},login_code_hash=NULL,password_ciphertext=NULL,password_nonce=NULL,password_key_version=NULL WHERE user_id=#{id} AND disabled_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM test_account WHERE disabled_at IS NULL AND expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY expires_at,user_id LIMIT 100
